policy: English-tagged only for comparison; unknown language retained for review. Age >=90 days at fixed recorded run start. Positive baseline and finite score. No historical raw records automatically recovered.
limitations: English tags are not independent audio verification
Cumulative views have unequal exposure ages
No per-video collection timestamp; recorded run start is an approximation
Prior history truncated by collection limits
Pooled distributions are descriptive; channel and topic confounding remains
Short duration does not establish Shorts format
Original run history describes the original collection, not a new collection
